subject: general
question:
select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets.

Despite facing numerous challenges, her [tenacious] determination never faded one bit.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Stubborn)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tenacious"** means someone who is very determined and persistent, refusing to give up on their goals despite challenges or difficulties. (दृढ़ / जिद्दी)

 
 
• **Example: **Her tenacious spirit helped her overcome all obstacles and achieve her dream.
 
 
 
• **"Stubborn"** refers to someone who is determined to do something and refuses to change their mind, often showing resilience or persistence. (हठी / जिद्दी)
 
 
• **Example: **Even when others doubted him, his stubborn determination kept him moving forward.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of "tenacious" is "stubborn."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Stubborn)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gentle **(मृदु): Someone who is kind, calm, and soft-spoken.

 
 
• **Example: **He has a gentle demeanor that puts everyone at ease.
 
 
 
• **Confused **(भ्रमित): Lacking clarity or being unsure about something.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt confused about which direction to take.
 
 
 
• **Weak** (कमजोर): Lacking physical strength or determination.
 
 
• **Example:** His weak arguments failed to convince the audience.
